blocks.text: Kuch pode inorganic nutrients ke ilawa organic molecules bhi apni ghiza mein shamil karte hain. Yeh organic maddey woh keeron (insects) aur chhote janwaron ko pakar kar aur tor kar hasil karte hain. Tamam insectivorous pode asal mein autotrophs hain (photosynthesis se apni ghiza khud banate hain). Lekin jab yeh shikar (prey) pakarte hain to in ki growth tez ho jati hai. Lagta hai ke janwar ke jism ke nitrogen wale compounds in podon ko faida dete hain. Pakre hue keeron ko patton se nikalne wale enzymes torte hain. Pitcher plant, Venus fly trap aur sundew mashhoor insectivorous pode hain.

Pitcher plant ke patte ek thaili ya surahi (pitcher) ki shakal mein badal jate hain jis mein kuch pani bhara hota hai (Fig. 8.1). Patte ka aakhri sira ek dhakkan (hood) ban jata hai jo surahi ke khule munh ko kuch had tak dhaanp leta hai. Surahi ke andar bohat se sakht baal (stiff hairs) hote hain jo andar gire chhote keeron ko bahar rengne nahin dete.

blocks.alt: Do tasveerein saath saath. Baen: pitcher plant ki surahi (pitcher) apni mudi hui bel (tendril) se latak rahi hai, peeche dhundla gulabi-bhoora pas-manzar; dhabbon wali bhoori-hari surahi ka kinara hara aur surkh hai aur munh ke upar bara halka dhakkan (lid) hai. Daen: kale pas-manzar mein halki peeli-hari surahi ka munh, upar chapta dhakkan aur kinare par phanse hue kale keere.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.1: Pitcher plant, keere patte ke andar phans jate hain (kitab ki Figure 8.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab mein yahan do tasveerein (photos) hain; yeh un ka saada khaaka hai. Patte ka sira surahi ban jata hai aur us ke munh par dhakkan hota hai. Keera chikne kinare se andar gir jata hai, andar ke sakht baal use wapas nikalne nahin dete, aur woh pani mein doob jata hai. Phir enzymes us ke jism ko hazam karte hain aur pauda nitrogen le leta hai.

Venus fly trap mein har patte ke sire par ek 'trap' (phanda) hota hai jo do lobes (hisson) se bana hai; yeh lobes ek qabze (hinge) se jure hote hain. Lobes ki andar ki satah par trichomes hote hain, yani baal jaise ubhaar. Shikar inhen chhoota hai to lobes foran band ho jate hain (Fig. 8.2). Trap ke kinaron par bareek bristles (sakht baal) hote hain jo band hone par aapas mein phans jate hain, is liye shikar bhaag nahin sakta. Phir patte ki satah ke glands se nikalne wale enzymes keere ko hazam (digest) karte hain aur bani hui cheezein jazb ho jati hain.

blocks.alt: Do tasveerein saath saath. Baen: gehre hare pas-manzar mein danthal par teen jaal (traps); kinaron wale do jaal khule hain, un ki andar ki satah surkh aur kinaron par lambe bristles; beech wala jaal ek keere par taqreeban band ho chuka hai. Daen: ek jaal ek bhir (wasp) par band ho raha hai, aas paas halke hare jaal.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.2: Venus fly trap, shikar patte ki do phankon (lobes) ke darmiyan phansta hai (kitab ki Figure 8.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab mein yahan do tasveerein hain; yeh un ka khaaka hai. Phankon (lobes) ki andar ki surkh satah par trichomes hote hain. Keera inhen chhoota hai to phankein foran band ho jati hain aur kinare ke bristles salakhon ki tarah aapas mein phans kar keere ko bahar nahin nikalne dete.

Sundew chamakdar 'dew' (shabnam) jaise qatron se shikar pakarta hai; isi se is ka naam para (Fig. 8.3). Is ke patte chhote chhote baalon se dhake hote hain jo tentacles jaise lagte hain. Har baal ke sire par ek gland aur shabnam jaisa ek qatra hota hai. Pode ki boo (odour) se khinch kar aane wale keere tentacles mein phans jate hain. Phir enzymes unhen hazam karte hain aur bani hui cheezein jazb ho jati hain.

blocks.alt: Do tasveerein saath saath. Baen: zaitooni pas-manzar mein upar se dekha gaya sundew ka gol patta; peele-hare tentacles phaile hue hain jin ke siron par surkh ghadood (glands) hain, aur narangi-surkh seene aur kale jism wala ek keera tentacles mein phansa hai. Daen: sundew ka patta apne shikar ke gird mud gaya hai, andar surkh tentacles, aur peeche bohat se surkh tentacles jin ke siron par shabnam ke qatre hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.3: Sundew, keere tentacles mein ulajh jate hain (kitab ki Figure 8.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab mein yahan do tasveerein hain; yeh un ka khaaka hai. Har tentacle ke sire ka qatra chipchipa hota hai. Chamak se aaya keera chipak jata hai (baen), aas paas ke tentacles aur patta us par mud kar use lapet lete hain (daen) aur enzymes use hazam karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek tamatar ke pode ke patton par gehre (dark) dhabbe hain, aur ek makai ke pode ke patton ki ragon ke darmiyan ka hissa peela hai. Har ek mein kis nutrient ki kami hai, aur woh macronutrient hai ya micronutrient?
blocks.explanation: Patton par gehre dhabbe potassium ki kami ki nishani hain; potassium macronutrient hai jo pani ka intizam karta hai. Ragon ke darmiyan peelapan (interveinal chlorosis) iron ki kami ki nishani hai; iron micronutrient hai jo chlorophyll banane ke liye zaroori hai.

items: Nutrients ya to energy dete hain (carbohydrates, lipids, proteins) ya metabolism mein madad karte hain (pani, electrolytes, minerals, vitamins). Nutrition yani nutrients lena aur istemal karna.

Nau macronutrients: C, H, O, N, K, Ca, P, Mg, S. Saat micronutrients: Fe, Mn, Zn, Mo, Cu, Cl, B. Har ek ki kami ki apni nishani hai, jaise nitrogen se stunted growth aur iron se interveinal chlorosis.
Insectivorous pode (pitcher plant, Venus fly trap, sundew) autotrophs hain; keere pakar kar enzymes se hazam karte hain aur un se khaas taur par nitrogen lete hain.
